provider: Lex.st — 150 GB free storage box 'for the life of the service'

free_tier.stated: 150 GB HDD RAID-6 (NVMe cached), 1000 GB bandwidth, 2 domains, jailed SSH, DirectAdmin, Salt Lake City. Free permanently.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

egress.terms: 1000 GB/month included. Metered and small; this is the binding limit, not the 150 GB.

tooling: Jailed SSH explicitly 'for rsync and the likes', plus DirectAdmin, plus NextCloud optionally available. rclone sftp works against jailed SSH if the jail exposes the storage path.
chaining: Application-gated, so not repeatable: signups go through a Google-Form review and the host states users with '~1-100 comments and that have recently signed up can expect to be rejected'. The filter targets the several-accounts pattern.
limits_note: Fixed storage quota is 150 GB with 1 TB per month bandwidth.
